idea: NORMAL regime SHORT filter — block SHORT entries when regime is NORMAL
rationale: Data shows SHORT signals lose -.13 net in NORMAL (13 winners +$0.54, 13 losers -$1.67). But they WIN in EXTREME (+$4.35) and HIGH (+$3.40). Filtering SHORT in NORMAL could save ~$1.13/7d without affecting EXTREME/HIGH wins.
risk: low — only blocks SHORT in one regime, EXTREME/HIGH unaffected
impact_on_winners: Checked: SHORT winners in NORMAL are small (+$0.54 total) vs losses ($1.67). Net positive to filter.

impact_on_winners: Checked: no winning pullback-entry- SHORT had RSI < 30 at entry (all were in 35-55 range)
